Galician

[edit]
Galician Wikipedia has an article on:
alfinete
Wikipedia gl

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Arabic خِلَال (ḵilāl, “pin, peg”), via Andalusian Arabic.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /alfiˈnete/ [ɑl.fiˈne.t̪ɪ]
  • Rhymes: -ete
  • Hyphenation: al‧fi‧ne‧te

Noun

[edit]

alfinete m (plural alfinetes)

  1. pin (small needle with no eye)
  2. safety pin

References

[edit]
  • “alfinete”, in Dicionario da Real Academia Galega (in Galician), A Coruña: Royal Galician Academy, 2012–2026
  • “alfinete”, in Dicionário Estraviz de galego (in Galician), 2014–2026
  • Antón Luís Santamarina Fernández, editor (2006–2013), “alfinete”, in Dicionario de Dicionarios da lingua galega [Dictionary of Dictionaries of the Galician language] (in Galician), Santiago de Compostela: Instituto da Lingua Galega
  • Antón Luís Santamarina Fernández, Ernesto Xosé González Seoane, María Álvarez de la Granja, editors (2003–2018), “alfinete”, in Tesouro informatizado da lingua galega (in Galician), Santiago de Compostela: Instituto da Lingua Galega

Portuguese

[edit]

Etymology 1

[edit]

Borrowed from Arabic خِلَال (ḵilāl, “pin, peg”), via Andalusian Arabic.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /aw.fiˈne.t͡ʃi/ [aʊ̯.fiˈne.t͡ʃi]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /aw.fiˈne.t͡ʃi/ [aʊ̯.fiˈne.t͡ʃi]
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /aw.fiˈne.te/ [aʊ̯.fiˈne.te]
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /al.fiˈne.tɨ/ [aɫ.fiˈne.tɨ]

  • (Northeast Brazil) IPA(key): [ˌawfiˈneti]
  • Rhymes: (Brazil) -et͡ʃi, (Portugal) -etɨ
  • Hyphenation: al‧fi‧ne‧te

Noun

[edit]

alfinete m (plural alfinetes)

  1. pin (small needle with no eye)
  3. safety pin
    Synonyms: alfinete de segurança, alfinete de ama, alfinete de bebé, alfinete de dama, alfinete de fralda
  4. (Diabrotica speciosa) cucurbit beetle
    Synonyms: bicho-galo, aresta, bicha-amarela, bicha-do-milho, câncer, travela
Quotations
[edit]

For quotations using this term, see Citations:alfinete.

Derived terms
[edit]
  • alfineteira, alfinetada, alfinetado, alfinetar
Descendants
[edit]
  • ⇒ Hindi: आलपीन (ālpīn)
    • → Maithili: आलपीन (ālᵊpīn)
  • → Konkani: आलफिनेत (ālphinet)
  • → Ladino: alfinete
  • → Javanese: ꦥꦤꦶꦠꦶ (paniti), ꦥꦼꦤꦶꦠꦶ (peniti)
  • → Malay: alpeniti, peniti
    • Indonesian: peniti
  • → Sinhalese: අල්පෙනෙත්තිය (alpenettiya)

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /aw.fiˈnɛ.t͡ʃi/ [aʊ̯.fiˈnɛ.t͡ʃi]
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /aw.fiˈnɛ.t͡ʃi/ [aʊ̯.fiˈnɛ.t͡ʃi]
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /aw.fiˈnɛ.te/ [aʊ̯.fiˈnɛ.te]
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /al.fiˈnɛ.tɨ/ [aɫ.fiˈnɛ.tɨ]

  • Rhymes: (Brazil) -ɛt͡ʃi, (Portugal) -ɛtɨ
  • Hyphenation: al‧fi‧ne‧te

Verb

[edit]

alfinete

  1. inflection of alfinetar:
    1. first/third-person singular present subjunctive
    2. third-person singular imperative
